title: Resistance force magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly calculated as 4000 N (or equivalent).

title: Acceleration time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly calculated as 5 s.

title: Instantaneous power
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly calculated as 48000 W (or 48 kW).

title: Acceleration at given speed
description: Essential: The final answer for part (4) must be correctly calculated as 0.5 m/s².

title: Applying power-velocity relation
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the relation P = F * v to find forces at maximum speed and other instants.

title: Applying Newton's second law
description: Important: The solution must apply F_net = m*a to relate traction force, resistance, and acceleration.

title: Identifying motion phases
description: Important: The solution must recognize that constant acceleration occurs only until the car's power limit is reached.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculations should maintain consistent SI units (kW to W, etc.).

title: Incorrect force balance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the resistance force is incorrectly assumed to be zero or if the net force is miscalculated.

title: Power misuse
description: Pitfall: Penalize if rated power is incorrectly used during constant acceleration without considering the changing traction force.
